page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1ne.8xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture using Intel Xeon 8269CY processors running at 2.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear tradeoff between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core performance is relatively weak, as shown by stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 25 percent, and single-threaded gzip compression ranking in the bottom 10 percent. However, the 32 dedicated physical cores compensate in parallelized workloads, delivering average multi-core performance in stress-ng, Geekbench, and Passmark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth for both cached small blocks and uncached large blocks remains consistently in the average tier.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.se1ne.8xlarge offers a dense memory configuration relative to its compute resources, making it suitable for memory-bound workloads that do not require high single-threaded clock speeds. The instance is well-suited for database operations, Redis caching layers, multi-threaded text and image processing, and static web serving. It can also handle moderate LLM inference tasks for small to medium models, though the lack of local NVMe storage and dedicated GPUs limits its utility for high-throughput deep learning or disk-I/O intensive databases.
